blocks.text: Fundamental particles yeh mane jate hain: chhe quarks, chhe leptons aur gauge bosons, jo fundamental forces ko 'carry' karte (ek particle se doosre tak le jate) hain. Leptons aur quarks bosons bhej aur le kar ek doosre se interact karte (asar daalte) hain. Maslan electromagnetic interaction tab hota hai jab do charged particles photons ka exchange (len-den) karte hain; kehte hain ke photons charged particles ke darmiyan force 'carry' karte hain. Isi tarah nucleus mein do quarks ke darmiyan attraction (kheenchao) gluons ke len-den se hota hai. W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons weak nuclear force ke carriers hain, aur gravitons (jo abhi tak dekhe nahi gaye) gravity ke. Higgs boson ek khaas particle hai jo 2012 mein CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein discover hua. Yeh Higgs field se jura hai jo poori space mein phaili hui hai. Is ka important role (kirdar) yeh samjhana hai ke doosre particles is field se interact kar ke mass kaise pate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab gauge bosons ke saath bracket mein '(Higgs bosons)' likhti hai, jaise Higgs boson bhi force carry karta ho. Aisa nahi: force carry karne wale gauge bosons photon, gluons aur W⁺, W⁻, Z hain. Higgs boson alag fundamental boson hai jo particles ke mass se talluq rakhta hai.

Jo particles Higgs field se zyada interact karte hain woh zyada mass pate hain, jaise electroweak force ke carriers W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons; jabke photons jaise particles Higgs field se interact nahi karte, is liye un ka rest mass zero mana jata hai. Higgs boson ka mass taqreeban 125 giga-electron-volts (GeV) hai aur yeh foran doosre particles mein decay ho (toot) jata hai. Kuch important baatein:

items: Higgs boson apna mass apni Higgs field ke saath interaction ki wajah se pata hai.

Apni khaas (unique) properties ki wajah se yeh Big Bang (kitab mein 'Bing Bang') ke foran baad universe (kaainat) ki halat aur dark matter ke signs (nishaniyan) dhoondhne ka unique portal (darwaza) ban sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Modern physics ki theories mein mass paida karne mein Higgs boson ka role (kirdar) bataiye (short question 12.14). Fundamental particles ke mass ka zimmedar kaunsa particle hai (MCQ 12.17)?
blocks.explanation: Poori space Higgs field se bhari hai; particles is se interact kar ke mass pate hain. Zyada interact karne wale, jaise W aur Z bosons, zyada mass pate hain, jabke photons, jo interact nahi karte, massless (bina mass) rehte hain. Higgs boson isi field ka particle hai; 2012 mein CERN par taqreeban 125 GeV par is ki discovery ne field ke hone ko confirm kiya. MCQ 12.17 ka jawab (d), Higgs boson.

items: Fundamental particles: 6 quarks, 6 leptons aur bosons. Force carriers: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W⁺, W⁻, Z (weak), gravitons (gravity, sirf proposed). Higgs boson force carrier nahi.

Higgs boson: CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein 2012, taqreeban 125 GeV; Higgs field particles ko mass deti hai (W aur Z zyada, photons zero); foran decay; shuru ke universe aur dark matter ko samajhne ka portal.
